_meta.source: Decoded from bundle-firstload-res config bundle (LOM 2026-02-28 capture)

stat_units.crit_def: /10000 (e.g., 20000 = 2.0x crit damage divisor; final crit_mult = max(1.5, crit_dam / crit_def))
stat_units.boss_def/pve_resist/total_dam_def: /10000 — only set on bosses if explicitly designed to resist boss/pve damage

formulas.boss_dam_application: if target.type==Boss and att.boss_dam>0: dmg = roundInt(dmg * (1 + boss_dam))

important_findings: All extracted bosses have boss_def=0 and pve_resist=0 — these are PLAYER-side stats. Bosses do NOT directly resist boss_dam/pve_dam.
Story chapter bosses scale crit_def from 1.0x (Ch1) -> 10.0x (Ch90+) — crit-heavy builds become noticeably less effective in late chapters.
Dark Trial final stages reach crit_def=20.0x (200000) — among the highest in the game.
Activity bosses (Pixel/Mashle/Summer/Punchman/NewYear/Christmas24/etc.) share a static HP scaling table (boss_id 1-4, 20 levels each, 20000*level capped at 200000).
Story bosses gain miss=80% (8000) and hit=10500 by chapter 90+ — evasion+accuracy ramp matter.

world_boss._description: 100 sequential levels in World Boss event. Each level has a unique boss unit.

palu_world_boss._description: Palu (Palworld collab) World Boss — 10 levels, mostly identical stats with a 10x HP jump at level 10.

activity_bosses._description: Damage-race event bosses — players damage a static target using boss-attack actions. HP scales 20000*level (capped at 200000). Used by IdolBoss(135), MashleBoss(1055), PixelBoss(5062), SummerBoss(5085), Punchman2Boss(4121), NewYear25Boss(5125), Christmas24MonsterFight(2049), SlumberFight(18), StarWarFight(4016).
